caption: A sheet of paper lies loosely over the grille of a large speaker, and it lifts and flaps with each beat of the bass.

sa.check: A sheet of paper lies over the grille of a large speaker.
The flapping comes in beats: repeated lifts with still spells between.
The paper stays on the speaker.

pc.expect: The paper lifts from the grille and falls back; it does not slide steadily or float off.
pc.fail: The paper slides steadily off the grille in one direction with no flap; or floats up and hangs; or flaps while lying on the floor away from the speaker; or its edges flutter as in a draught while the middle never lifts.

pc.expect: Each lift is followed by the paper settling back onto the grille; between lifts it lies flat.
pc.fail: The paper stays lifted in a hump and never settles; or is flat in one frame and airborne in the next and never comes down; or the lifts go on at the same rhythm after the paper has slid clear of the grille.

pc.expect: The paper falls back after each lift.
pc.fail: The paper hangs in the air above the grille; or rises steadily out of view; or climbs up the wall behind.

pc.expect: The paper flexes as paper and the speaker is rigid.
pc.fail: The paper stays rigid like a board while lifting; or the speaker cabinet flexes; or the paper tears with nothing touching it.

pc.expect: One sheet, one speaker; the paper does not pass into the speaker.
pc.fail: A second sheet appears; or the paper vanishes; or passes into the speaker; or the speaker changes shape.

pc.expect: The paper's markings, the speaker's colour and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The paper's markings change; or the speaker changes colour; or the room changes.
